# Contract payloads

Payloads the Go host and the Python sidecars really produce, committed so the UI's schemas are checked against them
([ADR 0069](../../../docs/adr/0069-payloads-are-validated-with-zod-behind-parsewire-and-a-wrong-shape-fails-loudly.md)).
**These files are generated by tests. Do not edit them by hand.**

- Go tests write and compare them through `apps/desktop/internal/contractfile`; Python tests through
  `narration_common.contract_files`. Both fail when what the code produces differs from the committed file.
- After a deliberate change to a payload, run the owning test with `UPDATE_CONTRACTS=1`, review the diff, update the schema in
  `apps/ui/src/api/schemas/` and the mock client together, and commit them in the same pull request.
- `apps/ui/src/api/wireContracts.test.ts` validates every file here against its schema, strictly (a key the schema does not
  declare fails), and fails on a file that has no schema.
